statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the watch threshold while geopolitical and cross-asset Stress stays extreme.
recommendation: Current evidence shows material Nasdaq-futures weakness but not a verified pathological one-way NQ path; the main conditional risk window remains the U.S. Treasury Iran-sanctions briefing and its immediate aftermath.
headline: Nasdaq futures weaken in Europe; Tail remains low ahead of U.S. event and sanctions checkpoints
body: Nasdaq-100 futures are roughly 0.7% lower in early European trade as elevated Treasury yields, semiconductor weakness and Iran-related uncertainty weigh on risk sentiment. Stress is extreme, but available evidence does not verify shallow/no pullbacks, repeated failed retracements or a persistent session-extreme hold.
